name: StackedShell
description: Mortar stacked shell: top Navbar with a centred page column and optional page header, Tailwind's stacked application layout.

props.navigation: NavbarItem[] (top-level LinkItem links, or a group { label: string; items: FlyoutItem[] } opens a dropdown panel of links ({ label; href; description?; icon?; current? }); a group holding the current page is marked current, and on narrow screens it opens inside the menu)
props.tone: "default" | "inverse" | "accent" (default "default"; the bar's surface. inverse: the other appearance, through the inverse token remap. accent: the brand's accent fill, its gradient when it defines one, with on-accent links, focus and actions. Dropdown panels keep the page's colours); passed to the Navbar
props.tabs: ItemGroup<TabNavItem> ({ label: string; items: TabNavItem[] }; a second row of page tabs under the bar, rendered as a TabNav named by label)

contract.usage: Import { StackedShell } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
